evidence.claim: ~60% global RV (rotate vector) cycloidal reducer market share; dominant supplier to FANUC, Yaskawa, ABB, Kawasaki industrial robots; humanoid robots adopting RV reducers for heavier joints (hip, waist) requiring higher torque density than harmonic
evidence.source: Industry analysis; Nabtesco investor materials; industrial robot supply chain reports

evidence.claim: Nabtesco revenue ¥150-170B; robot component division (Precision Reduction Gear) is largest segment; company noted humanoid robots as emerging demand driver in 2024 investor communications

RV reducer manufacturing requires precision cycloidal disc production with gear form errors below 3 microns; only Japan and limited European capability at this tolerance; Chinese domestic alternatives (Leader Harmonious) present but 10-15% lower performance
evidence.source: Technical analysis; precision gear manufacturing industry reports

evidence.claim: Nabtesco has larger revenue base than Harmonic Drive Systems (¥150B vs ¥30-35B) providing more financial resilience for capacity expansion; also supplies aerospace, rail, and construction equipment reducing pure robotics cyclicality
evidence.source: Nabtesco annual reports; segment revenue data

what_could_weaken_view: Humanoid architecture preference for harmonic over RV: harmonic reducers are lighter and more compact for the same torque ratio — if humanoid OEMs standardize on harmonic for most joints, Nabtesco's humanoid exposure is smaller than Harmonic Drive Systems

Industrial robot demand downcycle: Nabtesco's base business in conventional industrial robots is highly cyclical with auto/electronics capex; a manufacturing downturn compresses revenue even as humanoid demand grows slowly
Chinese domestic substitution: Chinese RV reducer makers have progressed further than in harmonic reducers; Nabtesco's moat at the mid-precision tier is narrower
Diversification dilutes bottleneck purity: Nabtesco's aerospace, rail, and construction equipment exposure makes it a conglomerate story, not a pure humanoid bottleneck play
